entries.headline: Weekly flu toll hits five-year high: 219 severe cases, 44 deaths
entries.why: Severity now drives the vaccination appeals from officials and doctors, and reports say the epidemic may not ease until November. This shapes the public programme (公費) narrative and private demand alike.
entries.headline_zh: 單週流感重症創五年新高：219例重症、44例死亡
entries.why_zh: 疫情嚴重程度成為官員與醫師呼籲接種的主要訴求，報導指出疫情可能要到11月才會趨緩。這同時影響公費計畫的論述與自費需求。

entries.headline: 1.32 million public flu doses in six days; Lo Yi-chun voices supply worry
entries.why: Uptake ran about 24% above last year and passed 1.91 million doses in eight days, and coverage links part of this to health coins. A senior figure publicly questioning supply makes 公費 allocation and replenishment a live issue ahead of the second stage.
entries.headline_zh: 公費流感疫苗六天接種132萬劑；羅一鈞表達供應疑慮
entries.why_zh: 接種量較去年高約24%，八天內突破191萬劑，報導將部分成長歸因於健康幣。高層人士公開質疑供應量，使公費疫苗的分配與補貨成為第二階段開打前的焦點議題。

entries.headline: Doctors urge adjuvanted or high-dose flu vaccines for older high-risk patients
entries.why: Clinicians frame enhanced vaccines around chronic disease risk, and one outlet reports a 143% higher death risk for kidney, heart and diabetes patients. Funding is mostly not stated in these reports. Separately, a clinic post makes comparative efficacy claims that raise advertising-rule exposure.
entries.headline_zh: 醫師呼籲高風險長者接種佐劑型或高劑量流感疫苗
entries.why_zh: 臨床醫師以慢性病風險為切入點倡議加強型疫苗，有媒體報導腎臟病、心臟病及糖尿病患者死亡風險高出143%。這些報導多未說明經費來源。另外，一則診所貼文提出療效比較宣稱，可能涉及廣告法規風險。

entries.headline: Self-pay flu stock patchy: Kaohsiung clinics say November, Lienchiang limits bookings
entries.why: These are self-pay (自費) signals. Users report clinics without self-pay stock until November, and Lienchiang County opened limited advance booking. Separately, posts say 公費 clinics stock a single brand (Medigen).
entries.headline_zh: 自費流感疫苗供貨不均：高雄診所稱11月到貨，連江縣限量預約
entries.why_zh: 以上為自費市場訊號。網友反映有診所自費疫苗要到11月才有貨，連江縣則開放限量預約。另有貼文指出公費診所僅提供單一廠牌（高端）。

entries.headline: Parents confused over new two-dose rule for children under three
entries.why: Coverage of the dosing change for 6 months to 3 years coincides with parents reporting conflicting clinic answers about catch-up doses and the subsidy ending in March. Other posts report fever after nasal spray vaccine. This mainly touches the 公費 programme.
entries.headline_zh: 三歲以下幼兒接種兩劑新規定，家長感到困惑
entries.why_zh: 6個月至3歲幼兒接種劑次調整的報導出現之際，家長反映各診所對補接種及3月補助截止的說法不一。另有貼文提到接種鼻噴疫苗後發燒。此議題主要涉及公費計畫。

entries.headline: RSV-linked cluster of 16 infants at Changhua postpartum care home
entries.why: RSV conversation rose from 3 to 16 items week on week. Infant-cluster coverage and posts on maternal RSV evidence put infant protection on the agenda, though funding is not stated.
entries.headline_zh: 彰化產後護理之家16名嬰兒群聚感染，疑與RSV有關
entries.why_zh: RSV相關討論由3則增至16則（週比較）。嬰兒群聚事件報導及孕婦RSV疫苗實證的貼文，使嬰兒保護成為討論議題，惟經費來源未說明。

watch.text: Second stage of the public flu programme opens. Watch whether supply concerns raised during the first-week surge resurface in allocation decisions.
watch.text_zh: 公費流感疫苗第二階段開打。觀察首週接種潮期間浮現的供應疑慮是否再度影響分配決策。

watch.text: Reports say flu may not exit the epidemic period until November at the earliest. Watch weekly severe-case and death counts against the 219/44 high.
watch.text_zh: 報導指出流感最快要到11月才會脫離流行期。持續對照219例重症／44例死亡的高峰，追蹤每週重症與死亡數。

watch.text: Kaohsiung clinics told users self-pay flu stock arrives in November. Track whether self-pay availability normalises or stock-out posts spread.
watch.text_zh: 高雄診所告知網友自費流感疫苗11月到貨。追蹤自費疫苗供應是否恢復正常，或缺貨貼文是否擴散。

qa.q: Is public-programme (公費) flu vaccine supply at risk before the second stage opens on 2026-11-02?
qa.a: Uptake is running well ahead of last year: 1.32 million doses in six days and more than 1.91 million in eight, with Kaohsiung reporting first-week uptake over 20% higher. Lo Yi-chun has publicly worried that supply may not be enough. The Taiwan CDC's notices urge early vaccination but do not address any shortfall, so allocation and replenishment are an open question.
qa.q_zh: 公費流感疫苗供應是否可能在2026-11-02第二階段開打前出現缺口？
qa.a_zh: 今年接種進度明顯超前去年：六天內接種132萬劑，八天內逾191萬劑；高雄市亦表示首週接種量較去年增加逾20%。羅一鈞已公開表達對疫苗供應可能不足的擔憂。疾管署公告呼籲民眾及早接種，但未回應任何短缺問題，因此疫苗配送與補貨狀況仍屬未知。

qa.q: What is the conversation around enhanced (adjuvanted / high-dose) flu vaccines this week?
qa.a: Several outlets carry doctors urging older high-risk and chronically ill patients to choose adjuvanted or high-dose vaccines, citing a reported 143% higher death risk for kidney, heart and diabetes patients; most of these reports do not state funding. A clinic post on Threads separately claims 20-30% better protection and 12-month coverage for an adjuvanted vaccine, which is a promotional claim that raises advertising-rule exposure.
qa.q_zh: 本週關於加強型（含佐劑／高劑量）流感疫苗的討論為何？
qa.a_zh: 多家媒體報導醫師呼籲高齡高風險族群及慢性病患者選擇含佐劑或高劑量疫苗，並引述報導指出腎臟病、心臟病及糖尿病患者死亡風險高出143%；這些報導多數未說明費用由誰支付。另有一則診所Threads貼文宣稱某含佐劑疫苗保護力提升20-30%、保護期達12個月，此屬宣傳性說法，有觸及廣告法規的風險。

qa.q: What are we seeing in the self-pay (自費) market?
qa.a: Social signals are thin but point to patchy stock: a Kaohsiung user reports two clinics said self-pay flu vaccine will not arrive until November. One TV report mentions self-paid vaccination, but the items include no price or demand data. Posts also say several 公費 clinics stock only the Medigen brand, which may push brand-conscious people towards self-pay where it is available.
qa.q_zh: 自費市場目前有哪些動向？
qa.a_zh: 社群訊號有限，但顯示庫存分布不均：一名高雄網友表示，兩家診所告知自費流感疫苗要到11月才會到貨。一則電視報導提及自費接種，但相關內容未包含價格或需求數據。另有貼文指出，數家公費診所僅提供高端廠牌，可能促使重視廠牌的民眾轉向有供貨的自費接種。

policy_notes.why: Sets the 2026 programme baseline: phase 1 for 11 groups from October 1 with about 6.449 million standard and 170,000 enhanced doses plus health-coin incentives.
policy_notes.why_zh: 確立2026年計畫基準：第一階段10月1日起開放11類對象，約644.9萬劑標準型及17萬劑加強型疫苗，並搭配健康幣獎勵。

policy_notes.why: Launch event confirmed 7.05 million flu doses procured including enhanced vaccine, the figure now used to judge supply adequacy.
policy_notes.why_zh: 開打記者會確認採購705萬劑流感疫苗（含加強型），此數字現為評估供應是否充足的依據。

policy_notes.why: CDC links ongoing severe flu activity to unvaccinated older adults and urges pre-holiday vaccination, framing the current severity narrative.
policy_notes.why_zh: 疾管署將持續的流感重症疫情連結至未接種疫苗的長者，並呼籲連假前接種，形塑當前的重症敘事。

products.name: Beyfortus
products.signal: RSV mentions rose from 3 to 16 week on week. Media reported 16 infants infected within 20 days at a Changhua postpartum care home, in a cluster linked to RSV, and a Threads post summarised European data on prenatal RSV vaccination. Nothing this week names infant antibodies.
products.implication: Infant RSV is entering the conversation through care-setting outbreaks and the maternal-vaccine route. That framing could shape how operators, parents and officials think about infant prevention options before antibodies are discussed at all.
products.action: Prepare a neutral evidence pack on infant RSV burden and the range of prevention approaches for institutional stakeholders. Track any official follow-up on the Changhua cluster, and keep reactive lines ready for media questions on infant prevention.
products.signal_zh: RSV提及次數由3則增至16則（週比較）。媒體報導彰化一家產後護理之家20天內16名嬰兒感染，群聚與RSV有關；另有一則Threads貼文整理歐洲孕期RSV疫苗接種數據。本週無任何內容提及嬰兒抗體。
products.implication_zh: 嬰兒RSV正透過照護機構群聚事件及孕婦疫苗途徑進入討論。在抗體尚未被討論前，此一框架可能影響業者、家長及官員對嬰兒預防選項的看法。
products.action_zh: 為機構利害關係人準備一份中立的實證資料包，說明嬰兒RSV疾病負擔及各種預防方式。追蹤官方對彰化群聚事件的後續處置，並備妥嬰兒預防相關媒體提問的回應口徑。
who_zh: 兒科及新生兒科醫學會

products.name: High-dose influenza vaccine
products.sub: Efluelda (菲優達), public programme for 65+ in long-term care
products.signal: High-dose mentions eased from 18 to 13 and enhanced-vaccine mentions fell from 82 to 28 as launch coverage faded. Doctors quoted in news are urging older high-risk and chronic patients to get adjuvanted or high-dose shots while severe cases and deaths hit a five-year high, and a senior official has voiced concern that overall flu supply may not suffice.
products.implication: Record severity plus doctor advocacy may raise questions about whether enhanced-vaccine eligibility, now limited to long-term care residents, should widen. Unregulated comparative claims online, including a clinic post flagged as misleading, raise compliance sensitivity for all enhanced brands.
products.action: Prepare an evidence and supply-readiness brief in case authorities or legislators ask about wider eligibility or allocation. Engage the programme on rollout data from long-term care facilities. Monitor clinic and media claims and keep all communication strictly non-promotional.
products.sub_zh: Efluelda（菲優達），公費對象為65歲以上長照機構住民
products.signal_zh: 隨著開打報導退燒，高劑量提及次數由18則降至13則，加強型疫苗提及次數由82則降至28則。在重症與死亡創五年新高之際，新聞中引述的醫師呼籲高風險長者及慢性病患者接種佐劑型或高劑量疫苗，且一位高層官員已表達流感疫苗整體供應可能不足的疑慮。
products.implication_zh: 創紀錄的疫情嚴重程度加上醫師倡議，可能引發加強型疫苗接種資格（目前僅限長照機構住民）是否應擴大的討論。網路上未受規範的比較宣稱（包括一則被標記為誤導的診所貼文），提高了所有加強型疫苗品牌的法遵敏感度。
products.action_zh: 準備實證與供應準備度簡報，以因應主管機關或立委詢問擴大資格或分配事宜。與計畫單位交流長照機構的接種數據。監測診所與媒體宣稱，所有溝通嚴守非促銷原則。

products.name: Tdap booster
products.signal: Little to report. Pertussis mentions went from 0 to 7, mainly from medical societies recommending respiratory vaccines, including pertussis, for COPD and asthma patients. No news or social items this week focus on Tdap.
products.implication: The chronic lung disease angle is a possible entry point for Tdap within broader respiratory-vaccine discussions, but visibility is minimal while flu dominates.
products.action: Keep monitoring. Map which medical societies are making respiratory-vaccine recommendations for lung patients and prepare background evidence for any follow-up discussion, without proactive outreach this week.
products.sub_zh: 成人及青少年百日咳追加劑
products.signal_zh: 無重大動態。百日咳提及次數由0增至7則，主要來自醫學會建議COPD及氣喘患者接種包括百日咳在內的呼吸道疫苗。本週無新聞或社群內容聚焦於Tdap。
products.implication_zh: 慢性肺病角度可能成為Tdap切入更廣泛呼吸道疫苗討論的契機，但在流感議題主導下能見度極低。
products.action_zh: 持續監測。盤點哪些醫學會針對肺病患者提出呼吸道疫苗建議，並準備背景實證以因應後續討論，本週不主動接觸。

issues.title: Supply adequacy questions as wider groups become eligible
issues.note: With more than 1.9 million doses given in eight days and a senior official already worried about supply, opening to more groups could bring shortage stories for both public and self-pay channels.
issues.title_zh: 擴大接種對象後的供應充足性疑慮
issues.note_zh: 八天內已接種逾190萬劑，且高層官員已擔憂供應，開放更多對象接種可能導致公費與自費管道皆出現缺貨報導。

issues.title: Pressure to widen enhanced-vaccine eligibility beyond long-term care
issues.note: Doctors are publicly urging enhanced vaccines for older chronic patients during a record-severity week, so questions to Taiwan CDC on allocation and eligibility are plausible.
issues.title_zh: 要求將加強型疫苗資格擴大至長照以外的壓力
issues.note_zh: 在疫情嚴重程度創紀錄的一週，醫師公開呼籲高齡慢性病患者接種加強型疫苗，因此疾管署可能面臨分配與資格方面的詢問。

issues.title: Scrutiny of comparative efficacy claims by clinics and media
issues.note: A clinic post promoting an adjuvanted vaccine with percentage-superiority claims drew high engagement and is flagged misleading, risking regulatory attention to how enhanced vaccines are discussed publicly.
issues.title_zh: 診所與媒體療效比較宣稱受到檢視
issues.note_zh: 一則診所貼文以百分比優越性宣稱推廣佐劑型疫苗，互動度高且被標記為誤導，可能引發主管機關關注加強型疫苗的公開討論方式。

self_pay.title: Self-pay stock lagging demand
self_pay.note: A Kaohsiung user reports two clinics said self-pay flu vaccine will not be available until November. Lienchiang County opened advance booking for self-pay doses with limited slots until sold out.
self_pay.title_zh: 自費疫苗供貨落後需求
self_pay.note_zh: 一名高雄網友反映，兩家診所表示自費流感疫苗要到11月才有貨。連江縣開放自費疫苗預約，名額有限，額滿為止。

self_pay.title: Clinic promotion of adjuvanted vaccine
self_pay.note: A clinic Threads post with high engagement invites people to get an adjuvanted vaccine, citing superiority claims flagged as misleading. This is a sign that enhanced vaccines are being marketed at clinic level outside the public programme.
self_pay.note_zh: 一則高互動的診所Threads貼文邀請民眾接種佐劑型疫苗，並引用被標記為誤導的優越性宣稱。顯示加強型疫苗正在公費計畫之外於診所層級進行行銷。

self_pay.title: Health coin and cost signals
self_pay.note: Coverage notes that health coins do not yet cover vaccines for checkups from January to September and that the ministry is considering expansion. A doctor's early-vaccination appeal also mentions the self-pay route.
self_pay.note_zh: 報導指出，健康幣目前尚未涵蓋1月至9月健檢時的疫苗接種，衛福部正研議擴大適用範圍。另一位醫師呼籲提早接種時也提及自費管道。

self_pay.title: No price, RSV antibody or Tdap self-pay signals
self_pay.note: This week's items give no clinic prices and say nothing about self-pay demand for high-dose flu, infant RSV antibodies or Tdap.
self_pay.title_zh: 無價格、RSV抗體或Tdap自費訊號
self_pay.note_zh: 本週內容未提及診所價格，也未涉及高劑量流感疫苗、嬰兒RSV抗體或Tdap的自費需求。
